start_here: Say to your AI: "Score the voice takes in /Work/demo/takes against my reference recordings in /Work/demo/refs and the voice I want, a warm, calm narrator, writing /Work/demo/scores.json." It runs tool:score-voice-takes-against-the-voice-i-want on your computer and shows each take's scores side by side.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads takes and reference recordings on your computer and writes the scores file you name.
instructions: 1. Install python3, numpy, librosa and the earshot listening package, and clone the Workshop (git clone https://github.com/Trillion-X/trillion-workshop.git).

2. Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs its run command on your computer: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/do-work/score_voice_takes.py /Work/demo/takes /Work/demo/refs "a warm, calm narrator" /Work/demo/scores.json
3. Compare each take's pitch, realness, match and typicality in scores.json and keep the best one.
